telemetry_age.query: SELECT min(observed_at) oldest,max(observed_at) newest,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE observed_at < now()-interval '7 days') older_than_proposed_7d FROM ohlcv_state_ingestion_observations

indicators_age.query: SELECT min(time) oldest,max(time) newest,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE time<now()-interval '90 days') older_than_current_90d FROM indicators

queue_completed.query: SELECT count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL) completed,count(*) FILTER(WHERE completed_at IS NULL) pending,count(*) FILTER(WHERE resource_block IS NOT NULL) blocked FROM pump_opportunity_label_queue

queue_candidates.query: SELECT count(*) eligible_rows FROM pump_opportunity_label_queue q WHERE q.completed_at < now()-interval '7 days' AND q.resource_block IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pump_opportunity_labels l WHERE l.observation_id=q.observation_id AND l.label_spec_hash=q.label_spec_hash AND l.horizon_minutes=q.horizon_minutes)

snapshots_age.query: SELECT min(timestamp) oldest,max(timestamp) newest,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE timestamp<now()-interval '48 hours') older_than_current_48h FROM indicator_snapshots

pump_expired.query: SELECT min(slot_at) oldest,max(slot_at) newest,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE slot_at<now()-interval '30 days') older_than_configured_30d FROM pump_opportunity_observations

config_extracts.query: SELECT config_type, CASE WHEN config_type='pump_opportunity' THEN jsonb_build_object('budget',config_json->'budget','research_lookback_days',config_json#>'{research,lookback_days}','candle_lookback_days',config_json#>'{research,candle,lookback_days}') WHEN config_type='shadow_l3_exit_policy' THEN jsonb_build_object('retention_days',config_json->'retention_days','capture_batch_size',config_json->'capture_batch_size') ELSE jsonb_build_object('flow',config_json->'flow','snapshots',config_json->'snapshots','flow_history',config_json->'flow_history','research',config_json->'research') END config FROM config_profiles WHERE pool_id IS NULL AND is_active IS NOT FALSE AND config_type IN ('pump_opportunity','pump_monitor','shadow_l3_exit_policy')
